crossRefs.note: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the…
Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder…

translations.web: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.
translations.bsb: Unable to head into the wind, the ship was caught up. So we gave way and let ourselves be driven along.
translations.kjv: And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let her drive.
translations.asv: and when the ship was caught, and could not face the wind, we gave way to it, and were driven.
